title: Create factory update script with rollback logic
description: Create /home/miner/factory-update.sh that implements the complete deployment logic including: set -euo pipefail, flock for single instance, fetch origin/main, check for new commits, tag current as rollback, hard-reset to origin/main, docker compose build factory, deploy container with health check, rollback on failure, and logging all outcomes to /home/miner/factory-update.log. The script must follow the exact decision tree specified in the feature brief and handle all the required failure cases with appropriate logging.

title: Create systemd service unit file
description: Create /etc/systemd/system/factory-update.service with Type=oneshot, ExecStart=/home/miner/factory-update.sh, and proper service configuration. This service should be used by the timer to execute the factory update script.

title: Create systemd timer unit file
description: Create /etc/systemd/system/factory-update.timer with OnUnitActiveSec=2min, Persistent=true, and proper timer configuration to fire every 2 minutes and catch up after reboot. This timer should activate the factory-update.service.

title: Create comprehensive README documentation
description: Create /home/miner/README.md with prerequisites (FACTORY_DIR git checkout, docker compose on PATH), installation steps (copy systemd units, reload daemon, enable timer), explanation of rollback behavior, and log file location. The documentation should be plain-English and cover all aspects needed for deployment.
